contentItem.title: 分比
contentItem.englishTitle: Separation of a ratio means taking the excess by which the antecedent exceeds the consequent in relation to the consequent by itself.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Separation of a ratio means taking the excess by which the antecedent exceeds the consequent in relation to the consequent by itself.
分离比是指超出先前水平,而后两者本身超出后一种水平。
